summary.problem: MCP servers configured in settings.json are not connected when running Gemini CLI in non-interactive mode (-p / piped stdin). Tools registered via MCP are unavailable, resulting in 'Tool not found' errors when invoked.
summary.root_cause: The non-interactive CLI entry points (runNonInteractive in packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts and packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCliAgentSession.ts) do not invoke config.initialize(). Config._initialize() in packages/core/src/config/config.ts is implemented to start MCP servers and await their initialization when not in interactive mode, but config.initialize() was never called during non-interactive execution.
summary.context: In interactive mode, AppContainer.tsx calls config.initialize() during startup, which starts MCP servers via McpClientManager and registers MCP tools into ToolRegistry. Bypassing config.initialize() in non-interactive mode leaves MCP servers unstarted.

steps: In packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts inside runNonInteractive, await config.initialize() if config.isInitialized() is false prior to setting up the chat session and scheduler.
In packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCliAgentSession.ts inside runNonInteractive, await config.initialize() if config.isInitialized() is false prior to setting up the chat session and scheduler.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When gemini CLI is invoked in non-interactive mode, config.initialize() runs and connects configured MCP servers, registering MCP tools for model use.
verification_steps: In packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts, add a unit/integration test case verifying that runNonInteractive calls config.initialize() and registers tools from configured MCP servers.
Run vitest on packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.test.ts to verify that non-interactive execution successfully initializes MCP servers and tools.

github_metadata.title: MCP servers not connected in -p (non-interactive) mode
